title: lissochilus ramosus
intro: Lissochilus ramosus, commonly known as the Hooked Helmet Orchid, is a type of flowering plant in the orchid family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include the reduction of inflammation and pain relief. The therapeutic actions of Lissochilus ramosus are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids and phenolic acids, although more research is needed to fully understand its effects.
